steps.text: It is late at night. Muffled sounds and suppressed screams can be heard from the prop room, which should be empty at this hour.
In a dark corner, the faceless faces of mannequins are illuminated by flashing lights.
Tippi cowers into a sofa, hugging a cushion tightly. The knife-wielding killer laughs maniacally, whose blade reflecting the bright white lights. In the very next instant—

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: EEK—

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: EEK—

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: What a classic! That one's one of my favorites. It may be a small-budget production from thirty years ago, but it stands up perfectly well to today's films!

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Phew... watching horror movies really does help let off steam. I feel better already. Thanks for the invitation, Tip.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Like, doesn't it feel better to just scream it all out? I know you didn't mean to interrupt the shoot. You were just on edge.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Yeah. I wouldn't say it's solved my issues... but at least I can forget about them for tonight. What are we watching next?

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: I've got everything. Horror night has just begun!

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Hey, why so serious, Molly? You didn't like the movie?

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: I was just thinking...

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: That knife looked a little too thin. I think it'd have had more impact with a more intricate design, like blood grooves on the sides of the blade.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: All work and no play makes Molly a dull girl! Turn off that work-brain already! Have you been spending too much time with Shelly?

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Mrrow~

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Hey there, mystery lady. Whatcha doing here?
The beautiful creature gets between the two girls, stretches, and sits in front of the sofa.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Clever girl. Looks like she really likes us, Molly. You wanna watch a movie together? But it'll be scary, so don't say I didn't warn you.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Hm? Whose terminal was that? Molly?

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Not mine.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Sorry... I've got to go.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: She looked really pale. Do you think Miss Stone is pissed at her about what happened today?

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Let's try to be there for her tomorrow too. She looks really tired.

steps.name: Moira
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Tippi
steps.text: Alright, fasten your seatbelt, it's going to be a bumpy movie night! This one won Best Design. The background, props, and weapons are all really cool.
The screen lights begin flashing again, immersing the two girls in another horror story. Neither of them notice that Miss.Christine is nowhere to be seen.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Shelly? I thought you were watching movies with Tip. What's the rush?
The overly friendly man notices that Shelly is clutching her terminal in her right hand.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Ah, I see... a sudden invitation to a date?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Well, try not to look so grim when you're there. I'm sure he'd rather see a smile.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: It's none of your business.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Your lips are trembling. You're cold. Or maybe afraid?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: You poor thing, you're still shaken about Dalton's accident, aren't you? Just like me.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Don't worry, with you as coordinator, I'm sure everything will go just fine. Come on, let me give you a hug. You could use the warmth.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: What do you mean, 'just like me'?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: I couldn't hear an ounce of fear in that trashy pick-up line.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Have you completely forgotten what happened five years ago?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Well, I haven't, because I'm not heartless like you. Don't forget: you're not free from blame for that accident either.
The light abruptly turns on in the office on the second floor.
On one desk, the papers are tidily filed away in folders, with hardly any sign of use.
On the other, notices are scattered all over, covered in editing marks as though the writer is troubled by something.
A tall figure searches around the desks, making not a single sound with his lithe and nimble motions.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Here.
The shredder has been used recently.
Lucian opens the waste bin, and picks up several strips of shredded paper that feel different from the others, different from the printing paper normally used by the film crew.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: 'Trimounts University'... 'Environmental Monitoring'... signed... 'Greta'.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: The 'unusual document' that Shelly mentioned.
He feels a slight push on his shoulder, seemingly in affirmation, but there is no one else in the room.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Welcome back, Miss.Christine.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: You've been taking more walks lately. Did something here catch your eye?

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: This place is more interesting than expected.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Indeed. I've discovered something unexpected myself.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Don't overthink this, Shelly... You're only here to see who's playing this sick joke.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: You saw that number become invalid with your own eyes. It... it can't be...
Shelly tries her best to calm down. The fear and anxiety she had briefly forgotten while watching the movie now takes over again.
'Go to the warehouse and atone for your sins.'
The terminal's screen glows in the quiet warehouse, showing the name of the sender. A name that is familiar, yet impossible—'Laura'.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Stop playing games. I know I'm not hearing things this time! What the hell do you want from me?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: What do you know?!
There is no answer. The darkness swallows all sound in the old warehouse.
She hears the tiny buzzing of electricity. A light suddenly comes on above a distant shelf.
As eerie as it is enticing, Shelly cannot help but walk toward it.
Shelly.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Laura... is that you?
Once again, Shelly starts trembling. She cannot tell if the sound came from deep within the warehouse, or from inside her own head.
She walks forward in a daze. It is as if she has returned to that set five years ago, where the tragedy occurred.
Shelly! I just got another scene and I need the wire rig. Can you prepare it for me?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Arrogant... cocky... proud... how dare you, a fresh face in Wrankwood...
Mr. Dalton said the director signed off on it...

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Dalton, still a star at the time, wanted to teach you a lesson, but you thought he was helping you... Are you happy with how it turned out?
Is he not here yet? I've spent hours up in this rig. My knees and elbows are probably bleeding by now... Can you please ask them for me, Shelly?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: I'm just a coordinator. All I can do is prepare the equipment and the rig. Make sure they're... safe...
Well, did you?
Shelly arrives before the shelf. The light shines upon a black dust bag. She knows what is inside.
Don't open it, Shelly. Don't.
Inside is an old wire rig set. The hook and tether are badly worn, and the harness is frayed.
There are dark spots on the black cloth.
Laura's blood.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: No! You can't possibly know!

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: You're just a hallucination! You can't be alive! Right... pain... I brought a pen...

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Ngh—
...How pathetic.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Why are you still there... Why didn't it work?!
Was the incident five years ago an accident... or a murder?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: An accident... it was an accident! It was a tragic accident that only happened because Dalton held a grudge against you!
Then why didn't you check my rig?
Why?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Because I hated you!

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: I hated your selfishness and arrogance! I hated that you made a mess out of the shooting schedule, and affected everyone with your unreasonable demands!

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: I was happy when Dalton decided to teach you a lesson! I was checking the wire rig as usual, and noticed it was due for replacement.

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Then, a little thought crossed my mind. What if an accident happened, and you were gone forever...?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Wouldn't that be... even better...?
Still in a trance, a hand pushes Shelly over. She hears the sound of coolant flowing through the pipes, and frost cracking beneath her.
She realizes that she had stumbled into the cold storage at the end of the warehouse.
But what can she do? Bang on the door? Shout? She has no strength left to struggle.
The fear is gone. She feels completely relaxed.
Death has answered all her questions.
